FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Still have questions? Chat with us →

Agle is an AI customer manager for creators and brands. It answers questions, handles complaints, completes tasks, books meetings, and routes important issues to the owner — automatically, 24/7 — through a branded page at agle.app/yourname.

Linktree shows links. Agle shows a full branded page with a built-in AI that knows your business. Your visitors do not just see buttons — they can ask questions, book meetings, and get order help, all without leaving the page.

Yes. Agle detects frustration, responds with your brand voice, and works on resolvable issues — checking order status, rescheduling appointments, and routing refund requests. When something needs a human decision, it escalates with full conversation context.

Yes. Agle supports GoPay, OVO, DANA, ShopeePay, QRIS, and bank Virtual Accounts through Xendit.

Under 5 minutes. Add your brand name, describe your business, and Agle generates your page automatically. No code needed.

Agle uses a confidence gate — if it is not sure, it says so honestly and escalates the conversation to you with a push notification so you can respond with exactly what is needed.

Agle is built for creators, influencers, and small brand owners who manage customer interactions alone — without a support team, without a CRM, and without a developer. If you are spending hours answering the same questions every week, Agle is built for you.

Yes. Agle's AI understands and responds in Bahasa Indonesia. You can configure the language, tone, and style — formal, casual, or mixed — to match your brand voice.

When Agle encounters something outside its confident handling — a complex complaint, an uncertain answer, a high-stakes request — it stops, notifies you via push notification, and hands you the full conversation with context. You only step in when it genuinely needs you.

Yes. Agle connects with Google Calendar and Calendly, checks your real-time availability, and confirms bookings inside the same chat conversation — no back-and-forth, no separate links your visitor has to find.

A confidence gate is a threshold Agle uses to decide whether it should answer a question itself or escalate it to you. If its confidence in the answer falls below the threshold, it doesn't guess — it says so honestly and routes the conversation to you. This is what makes Agle trustworthy.

Yes — Agle has an Android companion app on Google Play. You receive push notifications for new escalations, pending orders, and tasks that need approval, and can review and respond in seconds from your phone. iOS is coming soon.

Generic chatbots answer from scripts. When a customer asks something outside the script, they fail. Agle answers from your actual knowledge base — your products, policies, and brand information — so it can handle the specific questions your specific customers actually ask.

All connector credentials are encrypted at rest. Visitor conversations are stored per-thread, and you control what the AI knows through your knowledge base. Agle never shares your data with third parties.

Yes. The free plan is free forever — no credit card, no trial period. The Pro plan comes with a 14-day free trial. If you upgrade and decide it is not right, you can cancel anytime.
